method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: 2020 Revised Edition, informal consolidation in force from 5 December 2025; with the Employment (Retrenchment Reporting) Notification 2019 (S 200/2019), version in force from 1 November 2021

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the employee: s 2(1) (employee), ss 8, 10, 11, 13, 14, 15 (notice, breach, dismissal, suspension, wrongful dismissal), ss 21-24, 26, 27, 29, 32 (payment and deductions), ss 35, 37, 38(4) and Fourth Schedule (coverage, rest day and overtime pay), s 45, ss 76, 80(3), 81, 83 (maternity), ss 88A, 89 (annual and sick leave), s 95A, s 96A with the Retrenchment Reporting Notification 2019
